chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who marries a virgin, he (peace be upon him) said: 'He should stay with her for seven days.'

key_terms.الْبِكْرَ: A virgin woman (specifically one who has not been married before)
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: He stays/resides (implies remaining in the marital home)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended duration for a husband to stay with his new virgin wife after marriage according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the *iddah* (waiting period) for a virgin wife as seven days, a ruling derived from the Prophet’s practice and widely accepted in Shia jurisprudence. This period serves not only as a time for marital intimacy but also as a window to detect any physical defects (*ayb*) that might warrant annulment, reflecting the practical legal wisdom embedded in the Imams' teachings.
